articles.title: Household emergency supply inventory
articles.summary: A basic inventory procedure for recording and reviewing household emergency supplies.
body: Choose a single inventory location, such as a printed sheet or a locally stored document.
Record each supply item, quantity, storage location, and expiration date when applicable.
Identify supplies that are missing, damaged, or nearing expiration.
Review the inventory on a recurring schedule and update it after supplies are used.
Keep a printed copy accessible when electricity or internet access is unavailable.
